fusions.name: Bitter Mouthful
fusions.desc: Bites a target at or below 25% health for 16 damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hemlock Spit
fusions.desc: Spits chewed hemlock at the first enemy in its path, dealing 7 poison damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Shoulder the Blame
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and your allies, and restores 8 health to you.

fusions.name: Cast-Iron Gut
fusions.desc: Each time one of your afflictions lifts from an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.
